title: tp-link tl-sg2008 v3 | jetstream 8 port gigabit smart managed switch
description: The TP-Link TL-SG2008 v3 is a JetStream 8-port Gigabit smart managed switch designed for small to medium business networks. It features 8 10/100/1000 Mbps RJ45 ports and is integrated into the Omada SDN platform for centralized cloud management. This switch offers enterprise-level QoS, advanced Layer 2 management features including 802.1Q VLAN and Link Aggregation, and security strategies such as ACLs and Storm Control. Its durable metal casing and energy-saving design make it a reliable solution for growing business networks.
